subject: general
question:
The rectangle represents a set of calculations that are common across all the given equations. Identify the calculations involved and solve the fourth equation on the same basis:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05c62b09bf29f6233da261f7a0452de7159a3907a806256e2a15ab6147e5ab62.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

I) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e03ceb7245fed409169a2d812d9cdd0eeaa9e3eb6ccf024f9b11bff5160feba3.png] ⇒ [(7 × 4) - 1] ÷ 4 ⇒ [28 - 1] ÷ 4 ⇒ 27/4

II) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/797fd019070eb0f0afc61462c4a7b98b982efc9a3131c839ae18eb27497fd3ad.png] ⇒ [(6 × 1) - 1] ÷ 1 ⇒ [5 - 1] ÷ 1 ⇒ 5

III) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f775d1cab5dbd6d7471b9389746dfcceacbef0e49c8526c2de2b22086b65b18d.png] ⇒ [(4 × 3) - 1] ÷ 3 ⇒ [12 - 1] ÷ 3 ⇒ 11/3

Similarly,

IV) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/738f2cc60c42513d8baf7163e05b52d0cff5b2a521d1db012852627bbef9b8a2.png] ⇒ [(a × b) - 1] ÷ b ⇒ (ab - 1)/b

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
